entries.reason: Fireemu writes JSON members in sorted key order; production keeps its own order, and that order varies between production passes (RC-CLOSURE-A pass 1 and pass 2 differ in event payloads, the rollback answer's parameters and the 401 error metadata), so no fixed order can be matched. Member names, values and the layout length are still compared; only the order of emitted member-order differences is waived, never an escape, and never the defaults files, whose entry order follows the template (ruling 6). Documented in docs/remote-config.md.
